fields.SHOP_WELCOME_COMMON:
Welcome.
I've got some good items in stock!
fields.SHOP_PAL_WELCOME:
Hey there. I've got some great Pals in stock.
No funny business and only legit trading. Guaranteed.
fields.SHOP_PALDARK_WELCOME_1_1:
I trade in any kind of Pal...
Whether it’s stolen Pals, or even prohibited types...
Take a look...
fields.SHOP_PALDARK_EXIT_1_1: Heheheh, looks like meat's on the menu today...
fields.SHOP_PAL_RANDOMEVENT_WELCOME:
Thanks for saving me.
Why not buy something while you're here?
Relax, our Pal trades are legit.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_1_1:
A castaway?
Been a while since someone who didn't stink of Pals washed up here.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_1_2:
This island is a living hell. The people I came with aren't with us any longer...
Those damned Pals ate every one of 'em.
You be careful out there.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_1_3:
Here, take some basic supplies.
You need to toughen up if you want to survive out there.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_2_1:
...I'm so tired.
I tried making graves for everyone at first,
but when more than a hundred died, I gave up on that idea.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_2_2:
Here, ignorance leads to death.
There's a sliver of hope to be had if you manage to tame a Pal,
but not one of my comrades was able to accomplish that.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_2_3:
Hey...you have one of those ancient devices?!
With that, you should be able to make a Pal Sphere.
If you make some, you can catch Pals with them!
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_3_1:
You've got what it takes to be a Pal Tamer.
Craft some Pal Spheres, get out there, and catch some Pals.
Pal Tamers gain levels by catching Pals, you know.
fields.NOVICE_PALTIMER_3_2:
Stay away from that tower until you get a little stronger.
The Rayne Syndicate controls that place. They're a dangerous group.
You'll be killed for sure if you go now. My friends who tried ended up dead just like that.
fields.SKILLED_PALTAMIER_1_1:
You're a new face.
Don’t tell me...an outsider?
fields.SKILLED_PALTAMIER_1_2:
Not that it matters to me.
Now that you're on this island, why not try and catch some Pals?
You can get extra EXP for capturing up to 12 of the same kind, you know.
fields.SKILLED_PALTAMIER_1_3:
You know what they say, |Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they capture.|
Here, take this. I've got high hopes for you.
fields.SKILLED_PALTAMIER_2_1:
You know what they say, |Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they capture.|
Go out there and catch some Pals.
fields.Head_of_Village_1_1:
Have you ever been attacked by an enemy and lost a Pal? 
If you have, try asking the Pal merchant about it. They often find lost Pals.
fields.Head_of_Village_1_2:
If your Pal is on the market, you might be able to buy it back. 
The Rayne Poaching Group is selling Pals they've poached and stolen to merchants.
fields.Head_of_Village_1_3:
Really, what horrible people they are. 
I just wish someone could take down their boss...
fields.Police_dependable_1_2:
There's hardly anyone around here now, but
before the Rayne Syndicate came, many more people lived here.
fields.Police_dependable_1_3: Because of them, my income has really taken a hit, you know.
fields.Police_dependable_1_4:
If you're in trouble, let me know.
As long as you pay, I'll do anything.
fields.Shabby-looking_merchant_1_1:
Oh, are you a Pal Tamer by any chance?
Be careful, it's dangerous around here with the Syndicate lurking.
fields.Shabby-looking_merchant_1_2:
Better safe than sorry, eh? 
Fancy buying something?
fields.InnkeeperA_1_1: Welcome, haven't seen your face before.
fields.InnkeeperA_1_2:
Did you come from far away?
Must've been a long journey. 
Take your time and rest up.
fields.InnkeeperA_1_3:
Even though some time has passed since the catastrophe, still far from a perfect recovery…
We regret the lack of proper facilities.
fields.Rumor-loving_villagers_1_2: I've heard that caves are home to loads of unique Pals.
fields.Rumor-loving_villagers_1_3: What's more, there are even treasure troves created by Pals with a knack for collecting stuff.
fields.Rumor-loving_villagers_1_4: Give me a shout if you spot any caves, won't you?
fields.Research-oriented_scholar_1_1: Ever bumped into an extraordinarily strong and big Pal?
fields.Research-oriented_scholar_1_2: Just my speculation, but it seems to be some kind of leader who controls the Pals around!
fields.Research-oriented_scholar_1_3: If you could make it your ally, it would sure be handy. But it's super powerful, so be careful!
fields.DesertVillage001_1:
You did well making it here. There isn't much, but take a load off and relax.
It gets pretty cold at night, so don't forget to prepare.
fields.DesertVillage001_2:
Marcus, a PIDF big shot, keeps this village safe.
We can live in peace and quiet thanks to him.
fields.DesertVillage001_3:
That's why it's a good idea to keep your head down here.
Don't cause a fuss if you want to live a long life.
Be smart and do what I do—let the PIDF protect you and survive day to day.
fields.DesertVillage001_Loop:
Another peaceful day, thanks to Marcus.
Oh, right, be wary of the cold at night.
The temperature changes fast in the desert.
fields.DesertVillage002_1:
Now here's an unfamiliar face. First time in the desert?
Some friendly advice—prepare for some intense heat if you plan on going any deeper in.
fields.DesertVillage002_2:
Rumors say there's a legendary Pal living somewhere in the desert.
There's a never-ending stream of fools who stroll deep into the desert, never to be seen again.
fields.DesertVillage002_3:
I'm not fond of reckless Pal Tamers. But how about you?
If you're gonna take on the desert, don't fall into the same rut. Make sure you're well prepared.
Here, take this. I'm sure it'll be of use!
fields.DesertVillage002_Loop:
The legendary Pal somewhere deep in the desert...
No one comes back alive, so there's no way of telling what's true and what's not.
If you're gonna go looking for it, don't forget to prepare for the heat.
fields.DesertVillage003_1:
Hmph, just another aimless Pal Tamer by the looks of you.
What made you come all the way out to this blasted desert?
fields.DesertVillage003_2:
I can tell by the look in your eyes. You're here for the legendary Pal, ain't ya?
I'd stop while you're ahead if you don't wanna throw away that precious life of yours.
I've lived in this village a long time, and I ain't never seen no legendary Pal.
fields.DesertVillage003_3:
Even if it's real, it'd be so deep in the desert you'd never reach it. It's a load of baloney, I tell ya.
If you're still set on going, I ain't gonna stop ya.
Least you could do is take this with ya.
fields.DesertVillage003_Loop:
That legendary Pal... Just how deep in the desert is it?
Nah, forget about that. I'm parched.
Reckon you can drink sea water?
fields.DesertPolice001_1:
What's this, a new face? Marcus controls this region. I'm guessing you knew that before you came.
Don't think you can have your run of the place just because you're a traveler.
fields.DesertPolice001_2:
Just make sure you mind your P's and Q's. It's not rocket science.
We swear allegiance to Marcus, and the PIDF protects us. Simple as that.
fields.DesertPolice001_Loop:
No sir! Nothing to report!
Oh, it's just you... Don't startle me like that.
fields.DesertPolice002_1:
Hold on there. You want to enter the village?
Just make sure you don't go against the boss.
fields.DesertPolice002_2:
The boss is a kind man to those who obey.
He's even got the PIDF protecting us. There's a lot who thank him for that.
He keeps the peace around here.
fields.DesertPolice002_3:
But the boss is always around the tower with his officers.
Wonder what they're doing in a place like that...
fields.DesertPolice002_Loop:
The boss is up near the tower.
If the PIDF can get their hands on some ancient technology, they'll be unstoppable.
I bet the boss would be able to control the whole island!
fields.DesertPolice003_1:
Bonfires are so nice... Nothing beats the crackles and pops of a roaring flame.
Don't you agree?
fields.DesertPolice003_2:
Back in the day, you couldn't go on about mundane stuff like this.
Every day was a struggle between life and death... But everything changed when he came.
Thanks to him, we can live like proper human beings.
fields.DesertPolice003_3:
These days, you can make a bonfire like this without having to worry about attracting thieves.
This feeling of joy at something so simple... It's worth being thankful for.
Hm... Looks like it's about ready. Stay for a bite?
fields.DesertPolice003_Loop:
For the most part, fresh lumber is no good for burning.
But sometimes you've got no choice.
Humans can't live without fire.
fields.Police001_1:
Don't look at me like that. You trying to say I've done something wrong?
I'm not an officer any more.
fields.Police001_2:
I'm not even supposed to be here.
I nearly died after getting hit by a truck while on the job.
When I came to, I was on this island.
fields.Police001_3:
When I was sure I was dead, I prayed for a slice of <itemName id=|Pizza|/>.
Now I can make <itemName id=|Pizza|/> appear in my hand whenever I want. Pretty amazing skill, yeah?
Here, take a slice.
fields.Police001_Loop:
Come for some more <itemName id=|Pizza|/>?
That little trick makes me hungry. You've already had enough.
fields.VolcanoVillage001_1:
Catch anything?
Not a single bite here.
The old lady'll have my head if I come back empty-handed again.
fields.VolcanoVillage001_2:
If only I had a Pal I could rely on...
And if it could fish for me, I'd live like a king.
fields.VolcanoVillage001_3: Then I could ask it, |Hey Pal, you catch anything today?|
fields.VolcanoVillage001_Loop:
I wanna see my old lady smile. That's why I've gotta do my best to bring in a big catch.
Tell ya what, I'll share some with you if I get a big haul.
fields.VolcanoVillage002_1:
Howdy! Catchin' anythin' today?!
Oh, just a visitor?
Where ya from? Them's some nice clothes ya got on.
fields.VolcanoVillage002_2:
Haha, I've got ya figured out! You're one of them P-Pal whatchamacallits!
You're wantin' to get to the top of this here volcano, ain't ya?
All the strangers comin' through here are always goin' on about some tower up there.
fields.VolcanoVillage002_3:
Nothin' wrong with a bit o' mountain climbin', just make sure you're ready for it.
The heat round here ain't no joke. Gotta treat it with respect.
Go on, eat this—it'll give ya a bit of a boost!
fields.VolcanoVillage002_Loop:
If you're aimin' for the tower at the top of this here volcano, I won't stop ya. But... It's real hot up there.
No shame in comin' back down if ya run outta energy on the way up!
fields.VolcanoVillage003_1:
I-I saw it, I'm tellin' ya!
The other night there was this right beautiful shootin' star, but just as I was lookin' at it, it turned and left!
fields.VolcanoVillage003_2:
It was blazin' fast, too! I'm tellin' ya, that weren't no shootin' star.
And here I prayed for a mountain o' grub lookin' at it... Guess that wish ain't comin' true.
fields.VolcanoVillage003_3:
Now that I think about it, that thing has some wings comin' off it.
Could be it's still somewhere deep along this here volcano.
fields.VolcanoVillage003_Loop:
Not a soul believes me...
That shootin' star whatchamacallit went real far into this here volcano...
Gives me the shudders just thinkin' 'bout it.
fields.VolcanoVillage004_1:
Oh? A Pal Tamer in a little fishing village like this?
Well... Care to purify your mind and body in the pyre?
To us |Brothers of the Eternal Pyre,| the flame is a holy thing.
fields.VolcanoVillage004_2:
The pyre burns all to ash... It is as cruel as it is beautiful.
Sorrow and anguish, and the love that begets them... All should be put to the flame.
The words of the |Brothers of the Eternal Pyre| ring true, friend... Heheh.
fields.VolcanoVillage004_3:
But not too long ago, the head priest changed, and the new one's an elusive fellow.
Him and his followers are up to something at the tower.
They've been gone too long for mere prayer...
fields.VolcanoVillage004_Loop:
Wonder what kind of guy the new head priest is...
You might learn something if you visit that tower.
Anyway, care to join the |Brothers of the Eternal Pyre|?
fields.VolcanoPolice001_1:
Man, I'm bored...
Huh? You're not from around here, are you? No matter, you can pass.
Just don't get into any trouble, you hear?
fields.VolcanoPolice001_2:
Do my job and guard the place?
There's nothing to guard way out here in the sticks.
fields.VolcanoPolice001_3:
I'm just following my contract to the letter. I'm supposed to stand here at the gate, and that's it.
What rotten luck, getting assigned to some fishing village in the boonies...
fields.VolcanoPolice001_Loop:
Another boring day...
Yeah, yeah, no worries, I'm guarding the place...
fields.VolcanoPolice002_1:
Who're you? Guess it doesn't matter.
Look, this is just some plain old fishing village.
Take a load off and relax.
fields.VolcanoPolice002_2:
This place isn't all so bad, you know. It's a great place to sit around doing nothing.
Having nothing of note is both its greatest advantage and its greatest disadvantage.
fields.VolcanoPolice002_3:
Anyway, I found this lying around. Want it?
Not sure what it is, but it smells a bit like ammo after using it.
fields.VolcanoPolice002_Loop:
So that's what they call <itemName id=|Sulfur|/>, huh?
I remember seeing some stuff like that up on the volcano.
Don't you think it smells like fresh ammo?
fields.RandomBattle_PalTamer_Loop:
Thanks for the help. 
The security around here has gone downhill lately.
fields.RandomBattle_Police_Loop:
Appreciate the backup.
Keep an eye out for those poaching crews.
fields.PvPVillage001_1:
And here I thought I had finally escaped that blasted desert...
Nobody told me there was something that big living on this island!
fields.PvPVillage001_2:
Dang... If only I had what it takes to be a Pal Tamer!
I could catch a Pal, base, and survive out there!
fields.PvPVillage001_3:
Don't you go dying out there...
Here, take this. Hurry up and prepare for an enemy attack.
If you don't, you'll be dead meat when night falls.
fields.PvPVillage001_Loop:
Be extra careful if you run into any giant Pals.
They'll kill you in a heartbeat if you're not armored up.
fields.PvPVillage002_1:
You're new around here, aren't you?
A fellow wanderer, huh...
Why did I have to end up in a dump like this?!
fields.PvPVillage002_2:
I bet you're also just trying to catch some Pals and get rich quick, right?
Too bad—turns out Pals are ferocious, dangerous things.
All my friends have already kicked the bucket...
fields.PvPVillage002_3:
If you come across a giant Pal, steer clear of it.
Make sure you're well prepared before trying to take it on.
Catch a bunch of Pals and raise your level first.
fields.PvPVillage002_Loop:
Be wary of giant Pals.
First, you need to catch as many Pals as you can.
You'll need lots of experience if you want to take one on.
fields.PvPVillage003_1:
Oh, it's pretty rare to have anyone come through here.
You won't find anything interesting.
The Syndicate took everything we had.
fields.PvPVillage003_2:
If you can make Pal Spheres,
you can catch Pals and surround yourself with bodyguards.
The law on this island is that the strong eat the weak...
fields.PvPVillage003_3:
I'm so tired... There's nothing left for me...
Here, let me give you some of my supplies.
They have almost no use left for me...
fields.PvPVillage003_Loop:
I used to be a tough tamer like you...
Then I took an attack to the knee from that giant Pal.
On this island, those who can't fight can only wait for death to come to them.
fields.PvPVillage004_1:
H-Help! I don't wanna be here anymore!
A giant, scary Pal attacked us!
It chewed up and spit out humans like they were toys...
fields.PvPVillage004_2:
You have to catch some Pals and build a base before night comes!
You can't win in the dark of night!
Build a bonfire, hide, and pray until daybreak.
fields.PvPVillage004_3:
Use this however you can...
You have to survive—and escape this island!
fields.PvPVillage004_Loop:
If you run into some bloodthirsty Pals in the dark of night, you're done for...
Make a Hand-Held Torch, or build a base
and wait out the night somewhere safe...
fields.PvPVillage005_1:
Are you...a castaway? What rotten luck finding yourself here!
This whole area is known as Palpagos Island.
It's a terrible place where everything is decided by violence.
fields.PvPVillage005_2:
Some people come from outside looking to catch some Pals,
but most end up missing in action.
They either get eaten by wild Pals, or the Rayne Syndicate takes them out...
fields.PvPVillage005_3:
If you're a Pal Tamer, you need to catch lots of Pals.
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival, too.
fields.PvPVillage005_Loop:
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival
on this living hell of an island...
fields.PvPVillage006_1:
How many years has it been since anyone washed up here?
The last person who wound up here was some famous merc,
but they ended up just getting eaten by a Direhowl.
fields.PvPVillage006_2:
Pals are way more brutal than they look.
If you come across a carnivorous Pal, you best run.
Don't even think about looking back.
fields.PvPVillage006_3:
Here, use this. I'll be praying for
your survival in this cruel place.
fields.PvPVillage006_Loop:
We're close to that snow-covered mountain, so it gets fairly cold here.
You should hurry up and build a bonfire or a hut,
and get some rest in a nice, warm bed before you set out.
fields.BattlePaltamer001_1_1:
Oh, now that's a sight.
You're a Pal Tamer too, aren't you?
fields.BattlePaltamer001_1_2:
My goal is to become the strongest Pal Tamer.
Care to test your skills in a duel?
Following the island customs, it would be a fight to the death.
fields.BattlePaltamer001_1_3:
That means we'll both be putting our lives on the line.
Well? Wanna fight?
fields.BattlePaltamer001_2_1: Glad you said that! Let's make it a great battle!
fields.BattlePaltamer001_3_1:
Wise answer.
Once you've found your resolve, come here again.
fields.BattlePaltamer002_1_1:
Oh, I've found me a Pal Tamer!
I've been itching to see how strong I've gotten!
fields.BattlePaltamer002_1_2:
You're going to net me a nice bunch of experience points.
Let's fight!
fields.BattlePaltamer002_2_1: You'll need more than enthusiasm to win!
fields.BattlePaltamer002_3_1:
What a coward.
And you call yourself a Pal Tamer?
fields.BattlePaltamer003_1_1:
Heheheh...
So you're the Pal Tamer everyone's been talking about.
They say you've gotten pretty good for a rookie.
fields.BattlePaltamer003_1_2:
What an eyesore.
I'll snuff out your fifteen minutes of fame now.
Get those Pal Spheres ready.
fields.BattlePaltamer003_2_1:
Hmph, did you think you could win?
Know your place.
fields.BattlePaltamer003_3_1: Never call yourself a Pal Tamer again, you coward.
fields.BattlePaltamer004_1_1:
Hey there, rookie!
Looks like you've gotten the hang of using Pals.
fields.BattlePaltamer004_1_2:
But meeting me here... Looks like your luck is at an end.
Let's fight to see which one of us is the real Pal Tamer.
fields.BattlePaltamer004_2_1: I'll show you how a veteran brawls!
fields.BattlePaltamer005_1_1:
Whoa! What do we have here!
You look reeaaaal tough!
fields.BattlePaltamer005_1_2:
C'mon, let's fight!!
I'm talking a reeeaaal fight!
fields.BattlePaltamer005_2_1: Let's make this one hell of a battle!
fields.BattlePaltamer006_1_1:
Great... Another Pal Tamer meow?
There's been way too many weaklings these days.
I wish somebody else would take care of all of 'em meow.
fields.BattlePaltamer006_1_2:
If you're gonna fight with me, you're gonna have to show a little pluck.
And when you lose, make sure you kneel meow.
fields.BattlePaltamer006_2_1: No way you're gonna win, stupid kitten meow.
fields.BattlePaltamer006_3_1: So you're weak and a coward. What a hoot, meow.
fields.MerchantwithPAL_1_1:
These Pals, or whatever they're called, have an awful stench. It makes me want to vomit.
Don't you agree?
fields.MerchantwithPAL_1_2:
Hm? Not in the business? Must be a wanderer then.
Sorry, I've got nothing to sell you.
I'm delivering these goods to the next village over.
fields.MerchantwithPAL_1_3:
Y'know, there are these weirdos who throw away their money.
I just wanna sell off my stock
and get off this blasted island.
fields.MerchantwithPAL_Loop:
I don't give a damn about what happens to this trash.
All I care about are my goods.
Go on, try and put a scratch on 'em. I'll make you pay good.
fields.Assassin_1_1:
Hi there, Pal Tamer.
We're a merchant group that's here to support you...
Just kidding.
fields.Assassin_1_2:
You're just a little too good at making people hate you.
Don't take it personally. It's just business.
Now, off with you.
fields.Police_WarningOilrig_1_1:
Do you see that huge structure towering over the ocean?
That's an oil rig built by the Syndicate.
It's a dangerous place, so make sure to stay away from it.
fields.Visitor_Recruiter_Test:
Hey, let me hook you up with some Pals.
Wanna check 'em out?
fields.DOCTOR_WELCOME:
My name is Dr. Brawn! I'm a genius scientist pushing boundaries of pal science. 
I've been waiting for an eager test subject... UhーI mean, collaborator like you!
fields.DOCTOR_SURGI:
Would you let {SpawnedOtomo} undergo the latest Brawn Surgery?
If it succeeds, the result will be absolutely mind-blowing! ...Maybe?
So, what do you say? Ready to let {SpawnedOtomo} go under the knife?
fields.DOCTOR_SURGI_CHECK:
If, by some twisted miracle, the surgery goes wrong, {SpawnedOtomo} could end up with a 
permanent, irreversible, and absolutely terrifying side effect that’ll haunt them for life!
But I know you, my trusted partner in science—you'd still be all in for the sake of progress, right?
fields.DOCTOR_EXIT:
Ah... kids these days just don't have the gut to dedicate themselves to science. 
Back in my days, it was different! I used to make myself the test subject just to chase the truth!
fields.DOCTOR_SURGI_PROCESS:
Let's get started! First, the State-of-the-Art Transformation Ray!
Click... Click.. Oh, these readings are..? Well, no problem!
Zzzp...zzZZzap.. Now... the moment of truth! BOOM!!!!
fields.DOCTOR_SURGI_SUCCESS:
Oh! You're awake! What a marvelous hue and... unique look!
This is my greatest masterpiece... a historic work of art completed!
fields.DOCTOR_SURGI_FAILED:
...You're awake? Uh, well...
I guess being alive is something to be thankful for...
Cutting-edge research always comes with its costs. Don't let it get you down.
fields.DOCTOR_NO_OTOMO:
Hmm? Where is the test subject? 
It seems you don't have any Pals with you.
fields.DOCTOR_DAY_LIMIT:
My focus is completely fried today.
Come back tomorrow if you want to push the boundaries of pal science!
fields.FoodRequire_FirstEncout_1:
Well, well...I'm the esteemed gourmet critic and chief advisor to the Palpagos Gourmet Society.
I'll grace your dish with my refined palate, young upstart.
Though I doubt a drifter like you could possibly satisfy my discerning tastes.
fields.FoodRequire_Test:
I expect you to present me with {RequireCount} of your {ItemName}.
Rest assured, I have prepared a suitable reward for your efforts.
(Currently own: {ItemCount})
fields.FoodRequire_Yes_Success:
Aspara-gasp! This is a Frying pan-tastic {ItemName}.
As much as it pains me to admit, I must say it's delicious.
As promised, I shall reward you generously. Thank you.
fields.FoodRequire_Yes_Failed:
What? You say you don't have {ItemName}?
That’s disappointing... like a burnt pancake.
fields.FoodRequire_No:
Oh... You say you will not offer me a meal?
I may starve to death... that's a recipe for disaster!
It would be a great loss to the world if that were to happen.
fields.FoodRequire_BlockCircum:
Your culinary creations... I've savored them all.
It's been ages since my taste buds were so impressed... 
I'm truly satisfied... I’m off to my next course... Farewell.
fields.PalRequest_Request:
Hmph... I am the chief judge of the World Pal Exhibition.
I came to this region to see {PalName}, but it got away.
I will give you the honor of showing me {PalName}. You may thank me later.
fields.PalRequest_RequestSatified:
I see... So this is the rumored {PalName}. A splendid specimen... truly splendid. 
Hmph... Indeed, this was worth a look. 
Here's your reward. Impress me again next time.
fields.PalRequest_RequestUnsatified:
Foolish... To appear without {PalName} at such an opportunity.
You've wasted my precious time.
fields.PalRequest_NoRequest:
I've seen enough of your Pals... I'll allow you to leave as your reward.
Your display was more impressive than I anticipated...
Consider yourself thanked. Surprisingly, I found it quite enjoyable.
fields.Reach_PalDex_FirstEncout_1:
Nice to meet you. I'm researching Pal species and conducting an ecological survey, 
including unidentified species in this area...
You have a Palpedia, don't you? Would you mind showing it to me for reference?
fields.Reach_PalDex_FirstEncout_2:
If you manage to catch more species, I'd be happy to reward you for your efforts. 
Would you be willing to help me with my research?
fields.Reach_PalDex_Reward_1:
Fantastic! You've recorded {DexCount} species! 
This is incredibly valuable research data. 
Please accept this reward as a token of my appreciation.
fields.Reach_PalDex_Unreach:
You've recorded {CurrentCount} species so far. Try to catch {DexCount} next. 
There are likely more species in this area. 
If you discover any, please come show me!
fields.Reach_PalDex_AllReached_1:
This is an astonishing amount of data... It's more than enough.
Thanks to you, I've achieved remarkable research results.
I'll make sure to credit you by name in my research paper.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_FirstEncout_1:
Your eyes are no ordinary ones...
A gaze sharp as that of a hunter, truly remarkable.
I have a task I wish to entrust to someone of your skill.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_FirstEncout_2:
The mad ones who disturb this land, and the lives that have overrun it,
I ask that you hunt them down.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_FirstEncout_3:
...Rest assured. I do not ask for free labor.
A fair reward will be properly prepared for you.
Once you have finished the hunt, return to me once more.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_Reward:
Well done, here is the promised reward.
Please accept it without hesitation.
It seems my judgment was not mistaken.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_Unreach:
You have slain only {CurrentCount} creatures...? Not yet! It is still insufficient...
Once you have hunted down {DefeatCount} more,
return to me once again.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_AllReached_1:
You have indeed hunted enough...
Thanks to you, this land has, for a time, regained its peace.
I am most grateful.
fields.Reach_BossDefeat_AllReached_2:
Yet, unless the stake is removed, lawless scoundrels may rise again...
When that time comes, the hunt shall return once more.
fields.Reach_PalCapture_FirstEncout_1:
Hey... I'm the one who monitors the balance of this region's ecosystem, 
keeping an eye on the Pal population.
Right now, I’m looking for someone who can help reduce their numbers
fields.Reach_PalCapture_FirstEncout_2:
However, I can't bring myself to kill innocent Pals.
You, on the other hand... you're a Pal Tamer, right?
The more Pals you capture, the more I'll reward you.
fields.Reach_PalCapture_Reward_1:
Ah... so you've captured {CaptureCount}. Not bad at all.
Thanks for helping out with the ecosystem management.
Here, the promised reward. Take it.
fields.Reach_PalCapture_Unreach:
So, you've captured {CurrentCount}. Looks like you're still short of the {CaptureCount}.
Once you've captured enough, come back and see me.
fields.Reach_PalCapture_AllReached:
Thanks to you, Pal control in this area is more than sufficient.
No need for any more hunting... Protecting the ecosystem is important too.
I appreciate it. You've been a great help.
fields.EmoteTester_FirstEncout_1:
Hello there! I'm the Messenger of Love and Emotional Expression♪ 
I’ve come to deliver the refreshing joy your heart desires!
Now, let’s try 「{EmoteName}」 together! (Press <keyGuideIcon id=|PartnerPalInstructions|/> to open the menu and select 「<uiCommon id=|PLAYER_ACTION_RADIALMENU_EMOTE|/>」!)
fields.EmoteTester_Acted:
Wonderful!! That '{EmoteName}' was absolutely delightful!
Did you feel the atmosphere change? Isn't the power of expression amazing?
Here, this is a little bonus for your great effort♪
fields.EmoteTester_Request:
Don't be shy now~!
Open up your heart more! The '{EmoteName}' is the first step to love!
Come on, let's try it together!
fields.BountyNavigator_Common_1:
Want to know about the bounties?
They're people who are wanted for various reasons.
If you take them down, you can get rewards from the vigilante groups in settlements and towns.
fields.BountyNavigator_Common_2:
Do you know about the bounties posted by vigilante groups?
You can get rewards for taking down targets in settlements and towns.
Which bounty would you like to know about?
fields.BountyNavigator_Common_3:
There's a vigilante group fella over yonder, ain't there?
They say if ya take down them bounties, they'll give ya a reward.
I can tell ya 'bout the bounties 'round these parts. Wanna know?
fields.BountyNavigator_A_1_1:
It looks like recently, a poacher from a local gang 
has started getting a kick out of hunting newbies.
fields.BountyNavigator_A_1_2:
They keep attacking inexperienced Pal Tamers around here, 
then lying in wait to do it all over again.
fields.BountyNavigator_A_1_3: They're still waiting by the bridge near the village, so be careful.
fields.BountyNavigator_A_2_1:
That guy's a real troublemaker who's always dining and dashing in this village.
Here's how he operates:
fields.BountyNavigator_A_2_2:
After gorging himself at a restaurant,
he confesses to the staff, 'Actually, I'm a dine-and-dash enthusiast.'
fields.BountyNavigator_A_2_3:
Today, after pulling off his usual dine-and-dash,
I saw him escape to the top of that pointy hill over there.
fields.BountyNavigator_A_3_1:
They're a bounty hunter who hunts other bounty hunters.
Their method: spread false info about a bounty target as bait.
Clever, right?
fields.BountyNavigator_A_3_2:
Then, greedy bounty hunters swarm in.
That's when this guy shows up, as if they've been waiting for this moment,
and takes out all the bounty hunters in one fell swoop.
fields.BountyNavigator_A_3_3:
But here's the funny part: there's a bounty on these folks too.
Right now, they're probably ambushing bounty hunters near the Bridge of the Twin Knights
fields.BountyNavigator_B_1_1:
Apparently, this woman has 20 lovers at the SA~ME TIME. 
And what's more, she tells every single one of them, 'You're the only one.'
fields.BountyNavigator_B_1_2:
Recently, her lovers have even formed an organization called the 'Twenty-Timing Victims' Association.' 
The goal of the group? To 'divide her into twenty parts.'
fields.BountyNavigator_B_1_3:
Maybe she's scared of what they’re planning, 
but right now, she’s hiding out under the cliffs to the southwest of the canyon.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_2_1:
Oh, this is the person who used to be the interviewer for the poaching gang around here. 
Before even asking about your motivations, he apparently just say, 'You're wrong.'
fields.BountyNavigator_B_2_2: When you argue, 'But I haven’t said anything yet,' he reply with, 'That’s wrong too.'
fields.BountyNavigator_B_2_3:
Because of his intense interviews, the number of new recruits has dropped drastically. 
Turns out, he’s even been wanted by the very poaching gang he used to work with. 
Now, it seems like he’s holed up with a few of his buddies on a hill in the center of the canyon.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_3_1:
This lady, she’s got a really crafty way of pulling off land scams. 
Apparently, she sells the same land to multiple people, 
even going as far as forging the title deeds.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_3_2:
Recently, she’s even started selling land on the moon. 
It's 'luxury vacation homes on the moon,' and a lot of people actually bought in on it.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_3_3:
Thanks to this scheme, they’re making a fortune right now. 
I heard she's in the northwest part of the canyon today, 
coming up with new scams with their buddies.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_4_1:
Oh, you're talking about the legendary hit-and-run driver who used to scare the heck out of everyone?
Until recently, whenever you hopped on a Pal, you had to keep an eye out for this guy at all times.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_4_2:
But one day, the guy went straight into a flying Pal at meteor-like speed 
and ended up with major bruises all over.
fields.BountyNavigator_B_4_3:
The word is, he’s retired from the hit-and-run game now, 
and rumor has it he’s hiding out in the forest on the Sea Breeze Islands, south of here.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_1_1:
Ah, that milk-chugger? He steals <characterName id=|CowPal|/>s, milks them himself, and drinks it all. 
Last month, he stole 30 <characterName id=|CowPal|/>s and apparently chugged every drop of their milk in one go.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_1_2:
And you know what happened next?
Milk started gushing out of every part of his body,
turning the whole area into a milky mess, they say.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_1_3:
Now he's completely covered in <characterName id=|CowPal|/>s, 
and every time he walks, his footsteps make a 'moo' sound, they say. 
You’ll probably find him near the ruins to the west of the lakeshore.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_2_1:
Ah, that guy with the devil's tongue, huh? 
He's a master at turning any conversation into one about himself.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_2_2: Recently, he’s even gone as far as tying people up just to force them to listen to his stories.
fields.BountyNavigator_C_2_3:
Rumor has it, he shows up in the valley to the north of the lakeshore. 
Once you hear his story, your life’ll be sucked right out of you.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_1_1:
When this guy walks, it’s like a moving chimney, 
puffing out smoke as he goes.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_1_2:
The funny part is, his whole body’s practically turned into a ciggy. 
Flames shoot out of his fingers, smoke pours out when he exhales, 
and when he sneezes, cigarette butts fly out.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_1_3:
Tracking this guy’s easy. 
Look, the path made of cigarette butts leads all the way to that big arch over there.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_2_1:
These twins are a whole different level of crazy.
I’m telling you, you don’t want to get anywhere near them. 
They're out of their damn minds, thinking explosions are the highest form of art.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_2_2:
The older brother's all about big flashy explosions—'Flashy looks are justice!' he says. 
The younger one's obsessed with sound—'The louder, the better!' Real audio junkie. 
Makes no sense, right?
fields.BountyNavigator_D_2_3:
Just the fact that they’ve got a <characterName id=|ColorfulBird|/>.
makes it impossible to live on the same island as these freaks. 
They're in the lava zone east of the stream now, so go take them out.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_3_1:
That guy... he used to be a meticulous craftsman. 
But then one day, he started saying he was 'tired of chasing perfection,' 
and just... snapped.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_3_2:
Now he’s running around shouting, 'Mistakes are the highest form of art! Errors are perfection!' 
He even started messing up on purpose—when we thought he’d written the sign wrong, 
he deliberately hung it upside down.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_3_3:
He was such a pain that they kicked him out of the village and put a bounty on his head. 
Last I heard, he’s hiding near the waterfall in the middle of the stream.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_4_1:
You mean those guys? They started as a regular Free Pal Alliance, 
but then they went off the deep end. 
Now, if you say Pal's not cute, they’ll charge at you..
fields.BountyNavigator_D_4_2:
If you get caught by that guy, you’ll be forced to shout 'Pal’s cute!' 100 times.
Just the other day, a tourist got caught and had to practice the Paru dance for six straight hours.
fields.BountyNavigator_D_4_3:
Now he's tagging buildings with Pal graffiti, shouting 'Show your love for Paru!' 
I hear he's still out there, patrolling the terrace west of the stream, causing trouble.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_1_1:
This guy's a genius who breaks out of any prison in three minutes flat.
Started as a regular inmate until a guard challenged him:
'If you can get out of here, I'd like to see you try.' That's what set him off.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_1_2:
Now he turns himself in for fun, saying 'This cage looks interesting.'
Last month's escape: Picked the lock with a spoon, slid down soapy walls,
stole a guard's uniform, and walked out. Quite a show.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_1_3:
Apparently, he gets caught on purpose every time just to practice escaping.
The guy's truly insane, right?
Word is, he's hiding out somewhere on a hill far southeast of this town.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_2_1:
This guy used to be my boss.
We used to be traveling merchants together.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_2_2:
He was terrifying, using 'kind' words to pressure you:
'Maybe redo all your work?' 'Could you finish all this by tomorrow?'
Sounded nice, but he was a nightmare who'd push you to the brink.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_2_3:
Rumor has it he's looking for new 'disciple' in the western part of town.
He brags that 'Breaking someone's spirit is an art form.'
He'll say, 'I'd never make you work overtime~' while burying you in tasks.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_3_1:
This one's a real piece of work! 
Hangs around waiting for the traveling bard to perform, then shouts things like, 
'Guess what? The hero dies at the end!' all over the place. A real nuisance....
fields.BountyNavigator_E_3_2:
Recently, this one's been going around claiming they've got this new thing called the 'Spoiler Virus.'
Goes around saying, 'If I don't spoil things right now, your work will be wasted!' as an excuse to cause chaos.
fields.BountyNavigator_E_3_3:
This one's dedicated a whole life to spoiling things.
If you head to the lake north of town, you can always hear the latest spoilers.
But with a bounty on the head now, seems to be on edge.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_1_1:
That man was a fisherman who saw sum monster out at sea, and one day,
his personality just changed all of a sudden.
Now he's a crazy fella talkin' to himself all the time.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_1_2:
He went around drawin' 'dark magic cirlcle' all over the village, 
chantin' sum strange jibberish in the middle of the night and doin' what he call 'experiment.'
The village chief couldn't stand it anymore n' just kicked him outta the village.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_1_3:
The villagers are all scared and can't get any work done, 
so they want someone to deal with him quick.
Last I heard, he was spotted in the eastern volcanic area.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_2_1:
I really hope this fella gets punished soon, I tell ya.
Say things like, 'I Just wanna see them beautiful flames,' and sets fires only to put them out herself...
She's way past the point of a dangerous hobby.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_2_2:
Lately, she's been goin' around sayin', 
'Today's flames are 7.5,' and 'The way this buildin' burned was artistic,'
like she's ratin' the fires she starts...
fields.BountyNavigator_F_2_3:
She's itchin' to set this Fisherman's Point on fire too.
Word is, she's lurkin' nearby, waitin' for the right moment to blaze.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_3_1:
That fella... is a dangerous individual who destroys the very fabric of pizza tradition...
Yells, 'Pineapple is the KING of PIZZA!' 
while bargin' into other folks' meals and toppin' their pizza with pineapple without askin'.
fields.BountyNavigator_F_3_2:
Traditional recipies crafted with passion by pizza artisans over the years... 
She ruined 'em with her devilish deeds!
That sickly sweet juice kills the flavor of the cheese and the richness of the tomato sauce...
fields.BountyNavigator_F_3_3:
She can't see a pizza without feelin' the need to slap sum pineapple on it.
Word is, she's up in the ruins north of the volcano, 
gettin' high on pineapple pizza with her buddy <characterName id=|FoxMage|/>.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_1_1:
He's a broker who works between the vigilante group and the villigers...
On the surface, he acts like a 'mediator working for peace in the village,' but in reality,
he's a scoundrel skimming more tha half of the rewards.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_1_2:
He'll hire villagers saying, 'It's a request from the vigilante group! The reward is 5,000G!'
But in reality, they actually paid 10,000G.
While putting on a nice face, he's pocketing all of that difference.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_1_3:
Sometimes, he almost takes the entire reward, not just a cut.
Word is, he's hiding in the Abandoned Ruins.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_2_1:
He's a simple criminal who snatches kids he take a liking to.
A person who shouldn't exist in this world.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_2_2:
No one knows what happens to the people he takes.
Whether they're forced to work somewhere or sold off...
fields.BountyNavigator_G_2_3:
He's not a reasonable person, so don't bother trying to talk to him.
Just take him out.
Last I hear, he was seen near the frozen lake to the north from here.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_3_1:
I don't really want to give out info on this one... He's not a harmful criminal.
If possible, I'd like to help him.
He's just an unlicensed doctor diagnosing people on his own.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_3_2:
He says, 'I don't need money. If you're sick, I'll treat you,' and he does it for nothing.
I've heard he even goes deep into the mountain to visit kids with high fevers.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_3_3:
Because he doesn't have money, he uses medicine with unknown effects, 
so they say he's dangerous and put a bounty on him...
I heard he's hiding in the ruins north of Astral Mountain.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_4_1: This one's a drifter, a survivor. I've heard he's got a strange obsession with guns.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_4_2:
He makes new guns and then goes out, trying to use passerbys as targets.
He calls it 'Groundbreaking Field Testing,' but it's just plain madness.
fields.BountyNavigator_G_4_3:
He say things like. 'Let me aim at you with my new, more powerful model next!' and keeps chasing people.
Word is, he's honing his skill in the forest southwest of Astral Mountain.
fields.BountyNavigator_H_1_1:
This criminal is blinded by a love of sweets. 
She has a weakness for sweat treats and will even snatch dango from children if she finds them.
fields.BountyNavigator_H_1_2:
And, she leaves a 'list of improvements' at the place where she steals it.
The contents are said to be brutally harsh! She's got a heart as sour as umeboshi.
If dango isn't cooked to her liking, she even has her <characterName id=|WeaselDragon_Fire|/> to set the dango on fire!
fields.BountyNavigator_H_1_3:
Her special skill seems to be escaping with over 100 dangos stuffed in her mouth.
Just recently, there's a rumor she fled to the cape in the south of the island.
fields.BountyNavigator_H_2_1:
He was originally a skilled swordsmith. 
But then he went off the deep end, testing his blades on Pals and people.
Didn't take long for him to go completely wasabi-crazy.
fields.BountyNavigator_H_2_2:
Every night, he shows up on busy streets with a brand-new katana.
He goes on a rampage, attacking anyone he sees to test its sharpness...
Says he just can't wait to try it out.
fields.BountyNavigator_H_2_3:
This rotten seaweed scumbag is hiding out in the cemetary to the west of the island.
Do us all the favor. Make a sushi roll out of him and serve it to his own grave.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_1_1:
This is exactly the kind of threat that needs to be eliminated.
He was originally a popular chef. But over time, he started complaining,
'I can't be satisfied with ordinary ingredients!'
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_1_2:
One day, he declared he was in pursuit of the 'Ultimate Ingredient.' 
At first, he was eating rare animals, but then he started saying, 
'Humans are the finest ingredient!
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_1_3:
He actually turned his customers into ingredients. 
If we don't catch him soon, things will get out of hand...
He's hosting 'parties' with his comrades every day in a cave to the northeast of this island.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_2_1:
She was just a normal young woman who wanted some praise at first.
But no matter what she did, she couldn't get the attention she craved, 
and she lost her mind...
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_2_2:
She started screaming, 'The world is crazy for not recognizing my charm!' 
and turned into a monster desperate for followers.
She performs songs and dances everywhere, without caring about the trouble she causes.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_2_3:
She even got upset about the sketch on her wanted poster, 
demanding it be redrawn to make her look better.
I saw her dancing today near the white tree to the south.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_3_1:
He's already a legend.
He keeps stealing <characterName id=|FireKirin|/> that the people of the Fisherman's Port 
have worked hard to capture, even hireing mercenaries to help.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_3_2:
And his motives?
He just loves horses too much... he doesn't even mistreat the stolen <characterName id=|FireKirin|/>.
In fact, he brushes them everyday and feed them the best food he can find.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_3_3:
Seems like a good good person who loves Pals, but...from the perspective of the Fisherman's Port,
they probably want him dead.
There's a sightings of him near the large lake to the northwest of here.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_4_1:
This guy is the lowest of the low...
During the day, he walks around the village, scouting out the homes of the elderly,
and at night, he breaks in.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_4_2:
He broke into an old lady's house, living alone, and even stole her precious mementos.
He smiled and said, 'Your memories are worth money to me, and that's all that matters...'
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_4_3:
He's been banished from the Fisherman's Port and is now forced to live in a cave to the west of here.
We need to catch him as soon as possible.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_5_1:
He's a troublesome guy with the catchphrase, 'Just borrowing it for a bit!'
At first, it really was 'just a bit.' But it gradually escalated...
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_5_2:
Especially when he finds useful tool like axe or pickaxe, he says,
'This looks great~, let me just try it out for a bit.'
Then both he and the tool disappear... He's never returned anything.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_1_5_3:
Unfortunately, we still don't know where he is.
Since he got a bounty on his head, he's probably hiding out somewhere.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_1_1:
This guy... he's a real nutjob who 'collects' people.
Started off with dollies, but then he decided,
'I can't be satisfied unless they're real!'
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_1_2:
Now, whenever he finds someone he likes, he yells,
'I want to add you to my collection!' and chuck a Pal Sphere at 'em!
Crazy bastard.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_1_3:
Can you believe it? He's actually capturing people with those Pal Spheres!
Even his buddies are folks he caught with 'em.
Word is, he's lurking around a ship graveyard to the west, hunting for his next victim.
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_2_1:
Can't believe we've got someone counterfeiting gold now...
The world's going mad, I tell ya...
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_2_2:
That guy's a real piece of work.
Used to be a genius craftsman with the vigilante group,
but he got this crazy idea to make fakes better than the real thing...
fields.BountyNavigator_Yamijima_2_2_3:
And get this, it's not even about the money for him.
They say it costs him more to make those fake coins than the real ones are worth.
He's been spotted gathering materials near a big crystal to the southeast.
fields.SHOP_WELCOME_Caravan:
We're a traveling caravan passing through these parts.
It’s fate that we’ve crossed paths—take a look at our goods, if you’re interested.
fields.Presenter_001_1: To make it all the way out here, you must be quite the adventurer!
fields.Presenter_001_2:
It seems fate has brought us together here. 
Allow me to give you this as a token of our meeting!
fields.Presenter_001_Loop:
I wish you all the best on your journey as a Pal Tamer! 
May greatness be yours!
fields.Visitor_Ambassador_1:
Pardon me for the intrusion. Are you the one overseeing this territory?
...I see. As the rumors say, you certainly possess remarkable skills.
fields.Visitor_Ambassador_2:
Ah, I serve as an ambassador in a certain town in the desert region.
I happened to hear rumors of a rising star among the Pal Tamers.
fields.Visitor_Ambassador_3:
To start, allow me to present this as a token of our acquaintance.
I trust you will make good use of it.
fields.Visitor_Ambassador_Loop:
I sincerely hope that we can continue to build a friendly 
and cooperative relationship moving forward.
fields.Visitor_Blacksmith_1:
Whoa~, this base is amazing! 
You build this, huh?!
fields.Visitor_Blacksmith_2:
I’m just a lowly blacksmith!
Still trainin’, but one day, I wanna forge a real strong weapon
for someone tough like you!
fields.Visitor_Blacksmith_3:
Here, take this!
Made it as part of my trainin’, but ended up with extras, so I was stuck with 'em!
Ain’t no use me keepin’ it, so you go ahead and use it!
fields.Visitor_Blacksmith_Loop: One day, let me forge a weapon for you too, alright?!
fields.Visitor_Epicure_1:
…!
Oh, I’m not some suspicious person…
Just a… yes, that's right! A gourmet hunter, traveling the lands!
fields.Visitor_Epicure_2:
You always eat the same thing, don’t you!
S-So… here, take this.
Don’t get all grateful or anything
fields.Visitor_Epicure_3:
D-Don’t get the wrong idea!
I’m not worried about you or anything…
It’s just that, if you die in front of me, it’ll give me bad dreams, okay?!
fields.Visitor_Epicure_Loop: Honestly, you’re hopeless without me, aren’t you…!
fields.BountyTrader:
If you've got the skills, how about taking down a bounty?
They're vicious criminals that even the vigilantes can’t handle.
Bring me proof of their defeat, and I'll pay you handsomely.
fields.CHOICE_BOUNTY_SHOP_EXIT:
The information on the bounties should be with the informants scattered around.
Talk to them and track down the bounties.
fields.Yamishima_guide1_1:
Are you familiar with <itemName id=|Chromium|/>?
It’s a rare, island-specific mineral—surprisingly lightweight yet incredibly hard.
If repurposed for military use, it would be worth a significant amount.
fields.Yamishima_guide1_2:
<itemName id=|Chromium|/> is buried underground, and it can’t be found just by walking around.
However, with a metal detector, its presence can be confirmed.
fields.Yamishima_guide1_3:
I’ve mined a small amount myself, so I’ll share some with you.
If you can help reduce the threats on this island, it will be of help to me as well.
fields.Yamishima_guide1_Loop:
The Pals on this island are far more vicious than anywhere else.
If you're using a metal detector to search for <itemName id=|Chromium|/>, 
make sure you're thoroughly prepared.
fields.Yamishima_guide2_1:
The <characterName id=|PurpleSpider|/> that inhabits this island is absolutely incredible!
The webs it spins are strong enough to support our weight!
And on top of that, they’re incredibly flexible!
fields.Yamishima_guide2_2:
The <characterName id=|PurpleSpider|/> can move in three dimensions!
It climbs cliffs, clings to walls, and moves freely through the air!
fields.Yamishima_guide2_3:
It would be especially useful in the rugged mountain areas!
No matter what villains show up, you could escape with ease!
I’d love to catch one and sell it for a pretty penny!
fields.Yamishima_guide2_Loop:
If you ride the <characterName id=|PurpleSpider|/>, you can move in three dimensions!
Climb cliffs, cling to walls, and move freely through the air!
fields.Yamishima_guide3_1:
This is an incredible discovery! To think that Paldium could change shape like this,
I’ve never seen anything like it on any other island!
This glow... it’s as if it’s alive, holding life within it!
fields.Yamishima_guide3_2:
It looks like this crystal is resonating with the energy that envelops the island!
It could be the power of the World Tree, or perhaps... the lingering force of a catastrophe!
This is an absolute treasure trove of academic value!
fields.Yamishima_guide3_3:
Hmm... processing this level of hardness will be quite the challenge!
To craft with it, you'll need some serious skill.
But don't worry! I managed to get a few samples, so I’ll share some with you!
fields.Yamishima_guide3_Loop:
This crystal is truly a treasure trove of academic value!
Now, if we can just make it back to the lab in one piece...
fields.Yamishima_guide4_1:
Oh my god! I never heard it was this dangerous!!!
The blood-red earth, these strange crystals I’ve never seen before, and that eerie, guttural growl…
it's all so overwhelming, I can barely keep my sanity!!
fields.Yamishima_guide4_2:
Last night, one of my comrades was taken by that mysterious Pal from the darkness…
A hand reached out from the shadows of the crystals… No, I don’t even want to remember it!
They’re trying to devour us! It’s over… we’re done for!
fields.Yamishima_guide4_3:
Strange and rare Pals I've never seen before!
Mysterious, rainbow-colored crystals with bizarre powers… ultra-rare ores buried deep underground…
I heard rumors of untold riches and came all this way… only to end up in this nightmare!
fields.Yamishima_guide4_Loop:
Our ship is destroyed, and we don’t even know which way we’re going…
The only thing we were counting on, the flying Pals, was shot down by missiles…
It’s over… it’s all over…
fields.Yamishima_guide5_1:
...I was once under Jarl Bjorn's comand, It feels arrogant to even introduce myself.
The words of a coward who fled... are hardly worth hearing, I'm sure.
Nevertheless, there is something I wish to pass on to those who set foot on this island.
fields.Yamishima_guide5_2:
There are scattered Feybreak Army camps across this island… and there, you'll find anti-air missile turrets.
Weapons that automatically attack high-speed flying objects… terrifying machines.
If you value your life, stay on the ground.
fields.Yamishima_guide5_3:
Also, stay away from the tower.
Jarl Bjorn is still haunted by past wars.
Without a moment's hesitation, the Feybreak Army will attack as soon as they see outsiders.
fields.Yamishima_guide5_Loop:
I feel pathetic for having run away. But I couldn’t keep up with that war-thirst madman.
Jarl Bjorn is too strong. He’s a being that has surpassed the limits of humanity.
We mere mortals can never hope to match him.
fields.Respawn_guide_1:
If you ever get stuck somewhere and can't move, 
you can use the 'Respawn' option in the Options tab of the menu.
fields.Respawn_guide_2:
You'll drop your items and equipment, 
but you'll instantly return to your base.
fields.Respawn_guide_3: If there's truly no way to get out, it's worth a try.
fields.DeathPenalty_guide_1:
When you faint, you'll drop some of the items you were carrying,
but a pillar of light will mark the spot, so you can easily find them.
fields.DeathPenalty_guide_2:
You can pick up your items by touching any part of the pillar.
If you use a flying Pal to reach it from above, 
you can safely retrieve them—keep that in mind!
fields.ArenaShop_1_1: You can exchange Battle Tickets for various goods.
fields.ArenaShop_Exit: You will sometimes receive Battle Tickets for victories in the arena's Challenge Mode.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_UNLOCK_FASTTRAVEL:
In this region, you'll find Great Eagle Statues—transporters left behind by an ancient civilization. 
Activate them, and your journey will become far smoother. 

Start by touching the nearest statue to anchor your travels, and someday, you might just reach that towering spire in the distance.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_OPEN_SURVIVALGUIDE:
Countless pioneers and explorers have tried to conquer these islands, but most never made it back. 
Their hard-earned survival knowledge has been synced to your device. 
If you hope to make it through the journey ahead, your first step is simple: use <keyGuideIcon id=|UIEscape|/> to open the Options menu and take a look at the <uiCommon id=|COMMON_TIPS|/>.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_PICKUP_WOOD:
Of all the resources you can gather from nature, 
<itemName id=|Wood|/> is the foundation for nearly every tool and structure. 

Pick up fallen branches or strike nearby trees to start collecting.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_WORKBENCH:
Materials on their own are merely raw resources. 
By assembling a Workbench, you'll gain the ability to craft more complex items. 

Open the Build menu, select the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>, and choose where to place it. 
This marks your first step to building your base and surviving these wilds.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_UNLOCK_PALSPHERE:
On this island, coexistence with Pals is the key to survival. 
And it all begins with a single device: the <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>. 

Open the Technology menu and study its blueprint. 
The time has come to reclaim the power of the ancients.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_PICKUP_PAL_CRYSTAL_S:
These islands are home to an extraordinary mineral infused with supernatural energy: 
an ore known as Paldium. 
It's believed to be deeply connected to the massive tree towering in the distance, 
though the details remain a mystery. 

What we do know is that Paldium is a versatile material essential for crafting <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s. 
It's commonly found near water, so explore riversides and wetlands. 

If you spot something glowing blue, try striking it with a pickaxe. 
You can craft a pickaxe by combining <itemName id=|Stone|/> and <itemName id=|Wood|/> at a <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CRAFT_PALSPHERE:
<itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s are vessels used to capture Pals. 
Think of them as your key to companionship.

Craft <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s by combining materials at a <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
All you need is <itemName id=|Wood|/>, <itemName id=|Stone|/>, and <itemName id=|Pal_crystal_S|/>s.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CAPTURE_PAL:
Throw a <itemName id=|PalSphere|/> at a Pal to try and capture it. 
To boost your chances for success, weaken it first. 
Once you catch your first Pal, the two of you can form a bond unlike any other.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_UNLOCK_PALBOX:
To truly coexist with Pals, proper management is essential. 
Ancient records describe storage technology known as the <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/>.
 
Open the Technology screen to learn how to build one. 
The <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/> also has the ability to heal injured Pals.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BUILD_BASECAMP:
Open the Build menu with <keyGuideIcon id=|OpenConstructionMenu| iconScale=|0.7|/> and place a <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/> on a wide, open stretch of land. 
This will be your first base with your Pals—your launch point for future expeditions. 

If you maintain it well, it will become a vital stronghold when the time comes to face a tower, 
so choose your location carefully.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_WORKER:
Pals don't just fight, they can also work alongside you to help keep your base running. 
Access the <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/>, open the Management menu, and assign one of your Pals to the base.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_MEAL:
Whether you're battling or exploring, you can't forget to eat. 
Fortunately, this island is home to plants that bear delicious fruit. 

Keep an eye out for <itemName id=|Berries|/>. 
If you find some, open your inventory and use them to satisfy your hunger.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CRAFT_CLOTHARMOR:
The unforgiving wilds of the Palpagos Islands show mercy to no one. 
To protect yourself from the cold and harm, you'll need proper clothing. 

Unlock the <itemName id=|ClothArmor|/> technology and craft it at the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
You'll need <itemName id=|Cloth|/>, which can be made from materials dropped by fluffy Pals that bear <itemName id=|Wool|/>.
 
Time to go find something soft and wooly!
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_STATUS_POINT:
Gaining EXP and honing your skills are the keys to overcoming the challenges ahead. 
Once you level up, open your inventory and enhance one of your stats. 
Don't fear change—after all, every journey begins with a single brave step.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CAPTURE_PAL_SHEEPBALL:
In the Palpagos Islands, only the strong survive. 
<characterName id=|SheepBall|/> sit at the very bottom of the food chain, making them easy to catch. 

But don't underestimate them—their dexterity makes them surprisingly useful for all kinds of tasks. 
Try capturing five <characterName id=|SheepBall|/> to start. They'll be dependable first companions as you grow your base. 
Plus, they can provide essential materials like <itemName id=|Wool|/> and <itemName id=|Meat_SheepBall|/>. 

In this harsh world, the key to survival is simple: use every resource you can.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CRAFT_NORMALSHEILD:
In battle, you can't dodge forever. But fear not, you can harness the power of Paldium for defense. 
Unlock the <itemName id=|Shield_01|/> technology and craft it at the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
Equip it ahead of time, and you'll be ready for whatever surprise attacks come your way.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_GLIDER:
This island is full of dangers, and cliffs are one of them. 
One wrong step could cost you more than just a few scrapes. 

Unlock the <itemName id=|Glider_Old|/> technology and craft it at the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
With this tool in hand, even the highest drop becomes an easy-breezy descent.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CAPTURE_PAL_30:
This device includes a feature called the Palpedia, which collects and stores information on Pals. 
It can hold data for up to 12 individuals per species. 

Capturing more Pals also rewards you with bonus EXP. 
Start by catching 30 different Pals. 

With a wide range of abilities on your team, you'll be ready to take on even more powerful foes.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CRAFT_KITSUNEBIGEAR:
Each Pal has a unique Partner Skill with different effects depending on its species. 
Some can be equipped and controlled directly, while others can be ridden as mounts. 

First, unlock the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/> technology and set one up at your base. 
Then, unlock the <itemName id=|SkillUnlock_Kitsunebi|/> to craft it at your <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/>.
 
Unlike other items, Pal Gear is stored in the Key Items space next to your Inventory.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CAPTURE_BOSS:
Powerful Pals have carved out their own territories across the Palpagos Islands. 
They can be dangerous, but defeating them yields experience, and capturing them earns you formidable new allies.
 
How you deal with them is up to you. 
Rumor has it there's a Pal called {targetpal} somewhere in these wilds.

Track it down—whether you defeat or capture it is your choice alone.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BUILD_HATCHINGPALEGG:
Pals hatch from Pal Eggs. 
You can find these eggs all over the islands, so keep a sharp eye out while exploring. 

Raising Pals from Pal Eggs can lead you to rare and unique new allies. 
Who knows? One day, you might just hatch the perfect Pal. 

Start by unlocking the <mapObjectName id=|HatchingPalEgg|/> technology and setting one up at your base. 
Once you place an egg inside, you'll need to wait a while for it to hatch.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CAPTURE_BOSS_WITH_PLACE:
These islands are home to a Pal known as {targetpal}. 
Though it is fierce, challenging it might be the perfect chance to put your combat skills to the test. 
Find one and try taking it down or capturing it.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BASECAMPLEVEL:
Expanding your base is essential if you want your Pals to work efficiently. 
Raise your base to level 7 to create a more comfortable space for them. 
With the right setup, you'll be strong enough to take on that tower when the time comes.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_ZOE:
The time has come for you to challenge the tower of Zoe Rayne. 
Though she still doesn't fully grasp her role as its guardian, she has dutifully accepted all the same.
 
Claim victory in battle, and you may yet glimpse what lies beyond this tower.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_CRAFT_AUTOMEALPOUCH_TIER:
Hunger is your greatest enemy. 
No matter the situation, never forget to eat. 

Both you and your Pals can use <itemName id=|AutoMealPouch_Tier1|/>s to help you eat while on the move. 
Small conveniences like these can make a big difference in both exploration and battle. 

Like Pal Gear, the <itemName id=|AutoMealPouch_Tier1|/> is stored in the Key Items space next to your inventory.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_REGION_PRESERVE1:
Around the edges of the Palpagos Islands lie restricted zones known as Wildlife Sanctuaries, 
home to Pals with traits unlike any others. 

Among them, a Pal known as {targetpal} is said to possess extraordinary power. 
Capturing one could unlock entirely new possibilities.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_LILY:
Lily Everhart preaches coexistence with Pals, 
yet her love for them has grown into something extreme. 

That affection twisted into a doctrine that paints humanity as an irredeemable blight—and now, 
you are the only one who can stop her. 

Head to the tower on Frostbound Mountains and face her fanaticism head-on.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_MARCUS:
The PIDF, once meant to protect this land, has become the heart of its corruption. 
At the center of it all stands Commander Marcus Dryden. 

Under the guise of law enforcement, he engages in drug trafficking to line his pockets, manipulating the island's chaos to his advantage. 
But the desert he controls awaits the return of its true ruler—you. 

Head to the tower in the Desiccated Dunes and purge the rot with your own hands.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_AXEL:
Axel Travers, guardian of the Tower of the Eternal Pyre, is a juggernaut of a man obsessed only with absolute victory. 
He fights for no cause, seeking only one thing: a foe stronger than himself. 

He now awaits a worthy challenger at the mouth of Mount Obsidian.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_VICTOR:
Rumor has it that highly dangerous experiments are being conducted in the Astral Mountains, including genetic engineering to create new, artificially enhanced Pals.
 
Evidence indicates that Victor Ashford is the mastermind behind it all, but such crimes against nature come at a cost—one you must see to believe.
 
Journey to the peak of the Astral Mountains to put an end to his inhumane research once and for all.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_SAYA:
Like the soft glow of the moon above, Saya Kurosaki watched over the tower on Sakurajima, standing guard over a place where even time itself seemed frozen.
 
But after her recent encounter with a Pal known as the Blade of the Crescent Moon, 
she resolved to break the stillness at last. 

Head to Moonflower Tower on Sakurajima to put her conviction to the test.
fields.QUEST_MAIN_DESC_BOSS_BJORN:
The land of Feybreak was once struck by catastrophe. 
Amidst the chaos, Bjorn Seligsson took charge, guiding the people and guarding the tower there—
a duty he still carries out to this day. 

He often speaks about awaiting a fateful day of reckoning, 
but what he means by that remains unclear. 
Yet one thing is certain: those strong enough to face him may be the spark that changes everything.
 
Make your way to the tower at the heart of the Feybreak and bring salvation to its people. 
Only you can pierce the darkness of their curse.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_FARMER1:
Oh, I haven't seen you around before. 
Say, would you mind doing me a favor? 
If you have a Pal that can water crops, could you give it to me? 
There used to be plenty of Water Pals around here, but there aren't many left. 
Some shady group came through and took nearly all of them...
including my hardworking little Pal who always helped me with my fields. 
Lend me a hand, and I'll make sure you're properly rewarded.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_FARMER2:
Hello there! Feeling hungry by any chance? 
I just baked a cake with my family's secret recipe, but I got a little carried away. 
Now I have way more cake than I can possibly stomach by myself. 
It'd be a shame to let it go to waste, 
so would you mind sharing some with one of your Pals? 
I hope they've got a sweet tooth!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_FARMER3:
Oh, are you an adventurer? Perfect timing! 
Could you deliver this special dish to a nearby settlement for me? 
Give it to the super dependable-looking one—you'll recognize them right away. 
...What? Why don't I take it myself? 
Well, it's just that the dish smells so good that Pals keep swarming me, and I can't get anywhere near the place. 
So please, I'm counting on you! Just make sure the Pals don't eat it on the way!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_FARMER4:
Please, I need your help. My poor Pal is sick, and if this keeps up... 
The treatment is so expensive, I can't afford it on my own. 
I need 5,000 Gold Coins to cover the cost. 
I'm begging you—I promise to find a way to repay you somehow!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_SCHOLAR1:
Oh ho, you there! 
This is a bit sudden, but have you heard the old tales of the legendary Pals said to roam these parts? 
I've been studying them for many long years now, but not once have I laid eyes on one. 
Not even a glimpse. So I was wondering, would you be willing to search for them in my stead? 
My legs aren't what they used to be, see... 
Rumor has it that there's at least one legendary Pal in each of these places: 
Mount Obsidian to the west, the Astral Mountains to the north, 
the Desiccated Dunes out east, and the remote land folks call Feybreak. 
See that tall, jagged rock over there? If you climb to the top, you should get a good view. 
If you do manage to find one of those legendary Pals, 
would you be kind enough to let an old man see it with his own eyes? 
I'll be waiting, my friend.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_SCHOLAR2:
Hey there, skippy! You here to poke around these ancient ruins, too? 
I've been trying to crack this place's mysteries, but to tell you the truth, I haven't made much progress. 
At this point, my motivation is hanging on by a thread... But wait, I've got it! 
There are Pals out there that can boost work efficiency. 
If I had one of those, maybe that would turn things around! Ideally, 
it'd be a Pal that could handle these harsh mountain cliffs without breaking a sweat. 
So if you happen to find one, would you mind giving it to me?
In return, I'll give you something nice I dug up around the ruins. 
Something REAL special!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_SCHOLAR3:
Say, have you ever encountered a wild Fuack? 
Oh, how I long to observe one in the flesh! 
Why Fuack, you ask...? 
Isn't it obvious? They say it can generate its own waves and harness them for travel. 
Have you ever heard of a such a wonderfully bizarre Pal? 
Of course you haven't—nothing even comes close. 
If only you could bring me a specimen to examine up close. 
Just one will do! 
I'll make it worth your while, of course.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_SCHOLAR4:
Heh, fancy running into you in a place like this! 
Didn't think I'd be chatting with anybody but Pals all the way out here... 
Say, have you ever come across an ore called Chromite? 
I need mountains of it for my research, but gathering the stuff is no easy task. 
Especially for these old bones! Would you be willing to collect some in my place? 
Naturally, I'll repay you for your trouble.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_BREEDER1:
Hey, you... Yeah, you. Got a minute? 
Here's the deal: I've decided to become a Pal breeder. 
That's right, I'm gonna breed my very own Pals! 
Only problem is, I'm stuck at square one. 
They say you need cake to make the magic happen at a Breeding Farm, 
but that kind of thing's not really in my wheelhouse... 
That's where you come in. 
If you bring me five cakes, I promise to make it worth your while. 
And trust me, I'm a man who keeps his word.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_BREEDER2:
Oh, you came to see the cherry blossoms, too? 
Can't blame you...it's a beautiful spot. 
Sorry to bring the mood down, but could I talk to you for a minute? 
One of my Pals—been raising it for years—came down with something serious. 
Real serious. I've tried everything, but the medicine just isn't working. 
Truth is, I don't know what else to do. I brought it here to see the cherry blossoms one last time... 
It always loved them. If you've got any Advanced Recovery Meds, could you share them with me? 
I don't know if it'll be enough, but I'm not ready to give up on my Pal. 
I'll pay you back somehow, I promise.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_BREEDER3:
Dammit! Why'd those Rayne Syndicate bastards have to run up there of all places...? 
Hey, maybe you can help me! Some poacher scum stole my best Pal. 
I chased 'em this far, but then they went and climbed up that stupid ledge. 
I may not look it, but I've got a serious problem with heights. 
I'm begging you...get my Pal back! I'll repay you, I swear!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_BREEDER4:
Now that's what I like to see—another Pal Tamer! 
See, I'm trying to train myself a whole team of Splatterinas. 
Think you could catch about ten of 'em for me? 
I heard they hang around this area, 
but I haven't had any luck...
maybe 'cause they're just up ahead? 
Anyway, there's a reward in it for you if you help me! 
I don't like owing anyone any favors.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_RANGER1:
Hey, you're a Pal Tamer, right? 
Perfect! Could you find me a Pal to help me hunt?
I need one with Serenity. 
After all, keeping your cool is the most important part of the hunt. 
But with all this sand around, it'd be great if it could move smoothly over the dunes. 
Something like a living surfboard would be ideal—fun and fast! 
But do you think a Pal like that even exists...?
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_RANGER2:
Looking for something? If you've got a moment, I could really use your help. 
I've been tracking this bastard who's been island-hopping, setting fire to every forest they pass. 
Word is they're up ahead, but it's scorching hot... 
My gear can't handle the heat. 
Think you could teach them a lesson in my place? 
I'll have a reward ready for you!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_RANGER3:
Well, now! What brings you to a dangerous place like this? 
I was just about to go after an unusually large Tarantriss, but my gear didn't stand a chance. 
It must be the boss of the bunch. 
Say, why don't you take it on for me instead? 
It's a risky hunt, but if you pull it off, I'll make sure the reward is worth your while.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_RANGER4:
Oh, a Pal Tamer! Just who I wanted to see! I need a quick favor. 
Could you catch me some Beegardes or Elizabees? 
I want to gather some flower nectar, so either way, three Pals should be plenty! 
There's a spot nearby with loads of sweet-smelling flowers in bloom. 
I just know their nectar will hit the spot. 
So I'll stay right here, and you bring those Pals to me! Sweet deal, right?
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_NOMAD1:
You made it all the way up here too, huh? 
Then I guess you already know what's waiting just ahead. 
Yep...the trip down! 
I got so caught up in the climb, I completely forgot about the descent. 
My pack's too heavy, my legs are shaking, and I can't take another step. 
I could really use a Wumpo right about now... 
They're strong Pals—able to stomp through snow like it's nothing. 
If you find one, PLEASE let me have it! 
I'll trade you something really special!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_NOMAD2:
Hey! If you're all the way out here, you must be collecting twinkling treasures, too. 
I want to make a travel charm that'll keep me safe on the road, so I'm gathering Nightstar Sand. 
But it only glows at night... It's so magical, isn't it? 
Unfortunately, I've only managed to find a tiny bit. I could really use about ten more. 
Would you help me out? I'll give you something neat I found on my travels as a thank-you!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_NOMAD3:
Oh hey, are you looking for a dungeon too?
I came all the way out here to find one, but I haven’t had much luck...
So I figured I’d take a little break.
I heard there are Pals—Leezpunk and Leezpunk Ignis—that can help track down dungeon locations.
You wouldn’t happen to know one, would you?
If you do find one, let’s trade! I’ll give you one of my favorite items!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_NOMAD4:
The cherry blossoms drifting on the breeze feel heavenly, don't they? 
I'd love to take a slow, peaceful journey across the islands, 
but I figured it'd be even better with a Pal to relax with. 
Ever heard of a Pal called Yakumo? 
If you come across one with an Easygoing personality, would you be willing to let me have it? 
Not for free, of course! I'd give you some stuff I've gathered on my travels in return.
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER1:
If you've got a Pal that's good at watering, could you let me have it? 
Sure, I could haul water from the river myself, but Pals just seem to have the magic touch—
the vegetables always grow bigger and happier with their help. 
Please lend me a hand, will you?
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER2:
I've still got some cake left over... Would one of your Pals like a bite? 
If they've got a big appetite, they might just jump for joy! 
So, what do you say? It's scrumptious, I promise!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER3:
Go to the entrance of the nearby settlement and find someone who looks like they know what they're doing! 
Please make sure it gets delivered, all right? 
And once you're done, I'll be waiting right here with a thank-you gift!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER4:
I'm so close to being able to afford the treatment. 
I just need another 5,000 Gold Coins. 
Please, I'm begging you...could you help me?
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_SCHOLAR1:
Now then, off you go! Find those legendary Pals! 
We know there's at least one in each of these places: 
Mount Obsidian to the west, the Astral Mountains to the north, the Desiccated Dunes to the east, 
and the far-off land known as Feybreak. 
Climb up that big rocky outcrop over there to get a clear view of the area. 
And remember...I'm counting on you!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_SCHOLAR2:
Ugh, I have ZERO motivation to do...well, anything at all. 
Any luck finding me a Pal to boost my work efficiency? 
Ideally one that can scale steep mountains with ease. That'd get my butt in gear.
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_SCHOLAR3:
Well? I can't stand the suspense! 
Did you find me a Fuack?
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_SCHOLAR4:
So? Have you gathered any Chromite yet? 
If you had a metal detector, you might be able to uncover some buried somewhere on this island. 
Keep your eyes peeled, now.
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_BREEDER1:
Hey, did you manage to get those cakes? 
Five might be a bit much, but I'm serious about this breeding business. 
I'm counting on you!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_BREEDER2: Don't tell me—you brought some Advanced Recovery Meds to share?!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_BREEDER3:
