Please, you've gotta get my precious Pal back from those Rayne Syndicate goons! 
Hurry, they climbed up that ledge over there!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_BREEDER4:
Do you have any Splatterinas for me? 
Ten should be plenty for breeding. I'm counting on you!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_RANGER1:
I wonder if there's a calm, cool-headed Pal out there that can glide over sand like it's surfing. 
If you find one with an aura of Serenity, be sure to let me know!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_RANGER2:
I'll never forgive that creep... They're just up ahead. 
Please, give them the ass-kicking they deserve!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_RANGER3:
That huge Tarantriss is a real menace. 
If you're planning on taking it on, double-check your gear first...or else.
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_RANGER4:
Have you found any Beegardes or Elizabees for me? 
Just three'll do!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_NOMAD1:
I heard Wumpos are super strong! 
I wonder if they'd help me carry my stuff...
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_NOMAD2:
The sparkly stuff you see at night is called Nightstar Sand. 
It starts to glow after the sun sets. 
If you've got any to spare, could you share some with me? Ten should be enough.
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_NOMAD3:
Found any Leezpunks or Leezpunk Ignis yet? 
I've got a special item for you once you do!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_NOMAD4:
I wonder if there's an Easygoing Yakumo out there somewhere... 
I'd love to take a slow walk through these falling cherry blossoms with a Pal like that by my side.
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_FARMER1:
Thank you so much! 
Now my crops are sure to thrive!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_FARMER2:
Thanks a bunch! 
I'll definitely need your help if I end up baking too much again. 
So save some room for dessert, okay?
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_FARMER3:
So, the Pals couldn't resist the smell of my special dish after all! 
But I really appreciate you getting it there safely. 
Thank you so much!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_FARMER4:
Thanks to you, my Pal can finally get the treatment it needs! 
You really saved us. I'm so glad someone like you came along.
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_SCHOLAR1:
I knew it, I was right...! You actually found a legendary Pal. 
Unbelievable. Just who are you, exactly? 
I can't thank you enough. Time to get to work compiling my research notes!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_SCHOLAR2:
Woo, I'm fired up and raring to go! 
My motivation's through the roof! 
Thanks to you, the mysteries of these ruins don't stand a chance. Hoo hoo hoo!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_SCHOLAR3:
That yellow beak! That black tail feather! And those wonderfully peculiar eyes... 
It's Fuack, no doubt about it! I knew I was right to put my trust in you. 
Now then, time to dive into some serious Fuack research!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_SCHOLAR4:
Now I can finally focus on my research! 
You've done me a great favor, kind stranger!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_BREEDER1:
Looks like it's finally time to bring some baby Pals into the world! 
Hehe, thanks a ton!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_BREEDER2:
With this, I know my buddy's going to pull through! 
I can't thank you enough... 
Really, I owe you everything.
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_BREEDER3:
You're the best! 
Thank you so much!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_BREEDER4:
This is more than enough! 
All right, time to start cranking out Splatterinas!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_RANGER1:
Thanks for bringing me such a great Pal! 
We're heading out on a hunt right away! 
Something tells me we'll land a real prize!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_RANGER2:
Thank you for protecting the peace of the forest! 
Hope you can put your reward to good use!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_RANGER3: To take down a Pal that strong...you've definitely got the instincts of a true hunter!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_RANGER4:
Thank you so much! 
Now it's time to go and gather that sweet, sweet nectar! 
And if anything else comes up, I'll let you know!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_NOMAD1:
I had a feeling you'd come through for me. 
Now I can finally make it down the mountain in one piece! 
Thanks a ton!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_NOMAD2:
You're a sparkle hunting master! 
Thank you so much!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_NOMAD3:
With this little one, I won't get lost on the way to any dungeon! 
Once I've had a bit more rest, I'm heading out to explore!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_NOMAD4:
This is the travel companion I've always wanted! 
Just me and my Pal, strolling around with no rush... 
It's a dream come true, thank you so much!
fields.QUEST_BOSS_START_DESC_ZOE1:
Oh, it's that annoying cocky Pal Tamer from earlier! 
Don't go acting all high and mighty just because you beat me. 
Yeah, yeah, I know you're strong. But now I'm kinda curious to see what you're really made of. 
Catch a Grizzbolt and show it to me. If you can do that, maybe I'll give you some credit. 
They only show up in the No. 1 Wildlife Sanctuary—super dangerous territory. 
Grizzbolts are crazy rare and seriously strong. There's no way someone like you could catch one.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_START_DESC_ZOE2:
You again? Wow, you must really want to be friends with me. Weirdo. 
...All right, then. If you've got so much time on your hands, how about doing me a favor? 
There's this group we've been butting heads with forever, and lately some of my crew got roughed up by them. 
So I figured maybe you could handle a little payback. 
They go on and on about |protecting Pals| and |living in harmony with nature,| 
but when it comes down to it, they're just as violent as anyone else. 
We call them the Free Pal Alliance as kind of a joke. 
But don't get the wrong idea. 
Just because I said I respect your skills doesn't mean I trust you, got it?
fields.QUEST_BOSS_START_DESC_ZOE3:
You know... once, I ran away from the group with Grizzbolt. 
It was freezing at night. I remember finding this old scrap of cloth somewhere that we used to stay warm. 
Just a rag, really, but looking back... I think that was the first time I'd ever shared something with someone. 
Come to think of it, we were hiding in some ruins not too far from here. 
...Hey, could you try and find it for me? 
You're the only one I could ever ask for something like this.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_INPROGRESS_DESC_ZOE1:
So, did you manage to catch that Grizzbolt?
I heard there are plenty of other powerful Pals in the No. 1 Wildlife Sanctuary, too.
Probably a bit too much for you to handle.
But if you really want my approval, you’d better give it everything you’ve got.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_INPROGRESS_DESC_ZOE2:
Did you take care of those Free Pal Alliance weirdos for me? 
Or did you chicken out? Figures... Guess asking you was a mistake after all. 
Maybe I should just take care of it myself.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_INPROGRESS_DESC_ZOE3:
Did you find what I asked for? I think I left it near some old ruins, or what was left of them... 
But I guess there's no way it'd still be there. It's been years. 
Don't worry about it. I wasn't really expecting anything anyway.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_COMPLETED_DESC_ZOE1:
Wait, you... actually caught it? 
...All right, fine. I admit it. You earned my respect. A LITTLE. 
But just so you know, my Grizzbolt is still way stronger than yours!
fields.QUEST_BOSS_COMPLETED_DESC_ZOE2:
Well, well! You actually went through with it. 
Not bad! But to be honest, I can kinda see where those Alliance guys are coming from. 
I don't really know who's in the right anymore. 
Maybe it's time I gave it some real thought for once. 
But in any case... I'm pretty glad to have someone like you I can count on.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_COMPLETED_DESC_ZOE3:
That's it... Our blanket from all those years ago. 
There's no doubt about it. 
But I can't believe you actually found it. 
I mean, this kind of thing shouldn't matter to you, right? 
So why'd you go out of your way to do it? 
I... Thank you. I see you in a different light now. 
Y'know, I've got this feeling. 
Maybe someone like you really could make it across the sea.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_REWARD_DESC_ZOE:
...I think it's enough.
The tower, the group, even me. I don't even know what I was protecting anymore. 
So I've decided. 
This time, I want to see it for myself. 
Really see it. Let me witness your journey with my own eyes. 
Will you take me and Grizzbolt with you?
fields.QUEST_BOSS_START_DESC_ZOE_NOTCLEARD:
...What do you want? 
You're not from around here, don't get all friendly with me. 
If it's a fight you're after, fine—I'll take you on. 
If you're serious, come to the tower. 
Not that you stand a chance. Now get lost.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_START_DESC_ZOE_REPLAY:
Another Sphere? Seriously?
What are you, obsessed? Tch, whatever.
But no way I'm just handing it over.
Take down those Free Pal Alliance clowns for me.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_INPROGRESS_DESC_ZOE_REPLAY:
Not taken care of it yet?
I told you, teach those guys a lesson and I'll hook you up with a Sphere.
fields.QUEST_BOSS_COMPLETED_DESC_ZOE_REPLAY:
Oh, you're back, and you actually did what I asked.
Here, take it.
...And don't go losing it on me.
fields.CampPolice001_01: Welcome to the PIDF watering hole. You stopping by for a round?
fields.CampPolice001_02: Don't get any funny ideas, or we'll turn you into swiss cheese.
fields.CampPolice002_01: Whew... Nothing beats a stiff drink after a hard day's work.
fields.CampPolice003_01: Can you believe that some of these guys work sober? Couldn't be me!
fields.CampPolice004_01: Woah there, where are you goin'? You here to visit an inmate or somethin'?
fields.CampPolice005_01: The hell you lookin' at! You wanna see the inside of a cell?!
fields.CampPolice006_01:
This is the command room. 
The cells around here are full of dangerous inmates, so think twice before sticking your nose in.
fields.CampPolice007_01:
Hey, you. Care to lend me a hand? 
I've had enough work for one day, and there's a tall glass of beer waiting for me at the bar.
fields.CampPolice008_01:
The prisoner in here's a serious threat, from what I've heard. 
You can hear 'em mumbling to 'emself. Gives me the creeps.
fields.CampPolice009_01:
Hasn't the chief been hitting the bottle a little too hard lately? 
I could practically smell the liquor off him this morning.
fields.CampPolice010_01:
That bar next door sure doesn't help. 
And we're out here risking our lives on the daily, can you really blame him?
fields.CampPolice011_01:
My sole duty is to guard the chest behind me. 
Unless you're looking for trouble, you better keep your hands off it.
fields.CampPolice011_02: Got it? Don't even think about touching it.
fields.CampPolice012_01:
What do you want? I'm on my break. 
If you need something, talk to someone downstairs.
fields.CampPolice012_02: I told you, I'm on my break. Now beat it.
fields.CampPolice013_01: Kinda tempted to call it a day and head down for a drink...
fields.CampPolice014_01: Ever been jolted awake from a deep sleep? It's the absolute worst.
fields.CampPolice014_02: It oughta be a crime. First-Degree Aggravated Disturbing the Sleep.
fields.CampPolice015_01: Ahhh, nothing like a good drink. But... why's it got that weird gritty texture to it?
fields.CampPolice016_01: In a parched land like this, you gotta stay hydrated.
fields.CampPolice017_01:
All that's behind this door is some filthy corridor. 
Wouldn't miss it if it were gone. Makes you wonder why it's here at all.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_ANGLER1:
Perfect weather for fishing, huh? But wouldn't you know it, I haven't had a single bite all day. 
The {PalName} I've been trying to catch just won't take the bait.
{PalName} meat is so firm and chewy, I can't get enough of it! 
Say, if you manage to catch one, could you share a bit of the meat with me?
Just thinking about it makes my mouth drool...
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_ANGLER1:
Having any luck with fishing? You should be able to find {PalName} in these waters. 
If you manage to catch one, I hope you'll be generous enough to share a bit of its meat with me!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_ANGLER1:
Mmm, yeah! That's the stuff! 
This texture is to die for! Thanks a ton!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER3_ITEMLO:
You lost the food? No worries, I made more just in case! 
Just make sure it gets delivered properly this time, okay?
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_FARMER3_DELIVE:
...What's this? Is that for me? It smells absolutely wonderful. 
Thanks, I'll savor every bite!
fields.Visitor_Recruiter:
I've got a lineup of Pals eager to work under a Pal Tamer. 
There's a recruitment fee, of course. Care to take a look?
fields.Visitor_Recruiter_Exit: I'll swing by again when I've picked up some quality Pals.
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_ANGLER1_TIPS:
As thanks, here's a little fishing tip for you! 
Word is there are secret fishing spots where a |Lunker| can appear... though I haven't seen one myself. 
And apparently, the stronger the island's Pals, the more likely you'll find one. 
But tougher Pals mean tougher fishing, so gear up and sharpen those skills!
fields.FoodRequire_Test_NotUse:
I expect you to present me with {RequireCount} of your {ItemName}.
Rest assured, I have prepared a suitable reward for your efforts.
By the way, you still have {ItemCount} remaining to procure.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_KIGURUMI1:
Whoa, hold up! I'm not a Pal, okay? Don't go pulling out a Pal Sphere on me.
So what do you think of this costume? Spot-on Depresso, right?
Haha!
I absolutely adore Depresso.
Next thing I knew, I'd gone and made a whole costume.
Haha!
You know what would be fun? If I made you one as well.
Only problem is I'm out of supplies. Bring me the materials and I'll whip yours up straight away.
Bring 20 High-Quality Cloth and 100 Venom Glands. Now go, become a Depresso!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_KIGURUMI1:
Stop right there! I'm no Pal—don't throw that Sphere!
Oh, it's just you!
You're here about the costume, yeah?
Haha!
So, got the goods? I need 20 High-Quality Cloth and 100 Venom Glands.
It takes tons of Venom Glands to nail Depresso's beautiful coat, you know.
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_KIGURUMI1:
Take it, it's yours!
You're officially a Depresso now!
Haha!
And hey, if you've got an antique dresser, you can glam up your gear without changing its function.
That means you can always look like a Depresso, no matter what armor you've got on!
What a dream come true!
Live that Depresso life to the fullest!
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_ZOE5:
(Black base for sure... Orange and purple accents...)
Oh, it's you. I'm kinda in the middle of something here. What's up?
You know Halloween, right?
My team's been getting all into the spirit—literally.
So I set up a stage to match the mood, figured I'd play along a little.
But it still feels a little... empty.
...Excuse me? A costume? For me?
Why on earth would I do that? And it's not like I've got materials or a sewing kit. 
What—you're offering to make it?!
W-Wait just a minute! I never agreed to wear anything!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_ZOE5:
(...Ears like Cattiva's might be kinda cute...
If I'm going with ears, I have to add a tail too...
And maybe... Hmm...)
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_ZOE5:
...Wh-What?
Wait...
That thing you're holding... No way.
You actually made it? And you want me to wear it?!
D-Don't be ridiculous. I'm a Rayne Syndicate officer, you know!
...What? I mean, you don't have to throw it out...
Ugh, whatever!
It's not like I said I wouldn't wear it or anything.
Seriously...you're such a weirdo.
But, well...
Thanks.
fields.PalRequest_RequestNext:
Now… present {NextPalName} before me.
Do not falter in your attention.
fields.FoodRequire_RequestNext:
Your next challenge is {NextItemName}.
Let's see what you're really made of.
fields.PalRequest_RequestSatified_NotNext:
I see... So this is the rumored {PalName}.
A splendid specimen... truly splendid.
Hmph… Indeed, this was well worth the look. Here's your reward.
fields.QUEST_SUB_START_DESC_KIGURUMI1_REPLAY:
W-wait! I'm not a Pal!
Put that Pal Sphere away!
...Oh, it's you again. Something up?
Don't tell me—you want another costume?!
Haha!
fields.QUEST_SUB_INPROGRESS_DESC_KIGURUMI1_REPL:
W-whoa, stop! I'm not a Pal, okay?! Put the Pal Sphere down!
...Oh, hey, it's you!
Haha!
Still remember what I need?
20 High-Quality Cloth and 100 Venom Glands!
Come on, let's get that costume made!
fields.QUEST_SUB_COMPLETED_DESC_KIGURUMI1_REPLA:
Your suit's ready, take it!
Every time I craft one, I swear it gets more lifelike!
You see it too, right? Haha!
Anyway, have a great life as a true Depresso!
